hint.captureClientOnly: Client mode only saves the world area the client has loaded; container contents and entity data may be incomplete.
hint.correctionOutlineWidth: 1 uses the original line. Higher values use solid edges 0.5–4% of a block wide.
hint.vibrantVisuals: Recommended: turn off Vibrant Visuals while using this mod
hint.chatCommand: Type LHolo in chat to open the menu
checkbox.altWheelOffset: Alt + wheel to adjust the structure position
modal.titleExperimental: ⚠ Experimental features · Please read before use
experimental.warningIntro: Easy place / manual place / range place are experimental helpers that place projected blocks for you, automatically or semi-automatically.
experimental.warningAntiCheat: Because they simulate block placement programmatically, some server anti-cheat systems may treat them as cheating.
experimental.warningAllowed: · Use them only in single-player worlds, or on servers whose owner has explicitly allowed it.
experimental.warningConsequence: · Using them on a server without permission may get you kicked or banned.
experimental.warningResponsibility: · You accept all risks and consequences; the author and this mod take no responsibility.
experimental.warningManualSafe: Placing blocks by hand is always safe; assisted placement is only an experimental convenience.
checkbox.manualPlace: Manual place (right-click; hold to keep placing)
checkbox.easyPlace: Easy place (place when the crosshair is on a projected block)
checkbox.rangePlace: Range place (auto place nearby missing blocks)
hint.assistedDisabledByConsent: Assisted placement is off (accept the experimental notice first)
label.autoPlacementCooldown: Auto-place cooldown after a projected block is broken (0-60 s)
materialHud.title: Missing materials
materialHud.complete: All materials for the visible range are ready
status.restoredPending: Restored the saved projection; waiting to render
status.coordinatesInvalid: The projection exceeds the coordinate range. Adjust its offset.
captureStatus.singleplayerUnsupported: Single-player mode is not implemented yet
captureStatus.regionNotLoaded: The selection includes areas the client has not fully loaded
captureStatus.templateFailed: The vanilla StructureTemplate could not capture this selection
status.worldEventsFailed: World change tracking failed. Reload the projection to retry.
captureStatus.boundsInvalid: The selection is too large or its coordinates are outside the supported range.
captureStatus.exportQueued: Export queued for the next game tick.
captureStatus.exportFailed: The structure export failed. See the log for details.
captureStatus.selectionChanged: The world or selection changed. Review the selection and try again.
actionHint.projectionRestored: Back in the projection's dimension; projection restored
actionHint.noMatchingItem: No matching block in your inventory
actionHint.manualModeBlocked: Blocked by manual place mode (aim at a projected block)
hint.manualPlacementAllowedItems: Hold a listed item in your main hand to use vanilla placement inside or outside the projection, without LHolo swapping items or repeating projected placement. Enter inventory IDs (e.g. dirt or minecraft:scaffolding). Saved in your local settings.
hint.invalidAllowedItem: Enter a valid item ID. No wildcards, air, or block-state syntax. Maximum 128 entries.
hint.noAllowedItems: No exceptions: normal manual-placement restrictions apply.
schematic.summary: Correct %llu / %llu | Missing %llu | Wrong type %llu | Extra %llu | Wrong state %llu | Unknown %llu
schematic.pending: Verification in progress. This scan stops when it completes.
schematic.truncated: Showing up to 1536 nearest rows: 512 missing, 512 wrong-state, and 512 shared by wrong-type and extra. Counts cover the entire visible range.
schematic.highlightHint: Select a row to highlight that block position.
verifier.manualHint: Start scan runs once and never restarts automatically. Reset discards only the result and selection.
verifier.queued: Waiting for the selected schematic to finish loading.
verifier.cancelled: Scan stopped. Start scan begins a new check.
verifier.notVerified: Not verified. Start scan to check the current placement.
verifier.completed: Verification complete. These are the results of the last manual update.
verifier.noPlacement: Select a placement on the Schematics page first.
hotkey.routeReserved: F11 is reserved for fullscreen; direct shortcut disabled.
hotkey.routeUnavailable: Direct shortcuts unavailable: text input tracking is not ready.
hint.filesHowTo: In a world: Browse and Load a file, or refresh the library and place a listed file at your feet. Select the created placement on Placed.
hint.placedHowTo: Select a placement to edit its position, rotation and mirror. Visibility hides it. Deleting a placement retains its source file.
hint.transformHowTo: X is east/west, Y is height, Z is north/south. Edit numbers or use +/-. Default movement: Ctrl+arrows horizontally, Shift+Up/Down vertically. Alt+wheel moves the projection forward/backward.
hint.materialsHowTo: Select a placement and refresh materials. Counts are total / correct / remaining / inventory. Unavailable inventory is not zero. Results belong to the last manual update.
hint.hotkeysHowTo: Click a binding and press the new key. Esc cancels; Delete/Backspace or Clear unbinds; Reset restores defaults. --- means unbound. Gameplay actions require free game input; menu/direct-page bindings also work in mod menus.
hint.hudHowTo: Schematic HUD defaults on; material HUD defaults off. Choose fields and corner. Praxis HUD Layout supports detailed placement and scale. Unavailable information remains unavailable.
hint.captureHowTo: In a world, set both points using coordinates or player position, then export .mcstructure. Only loaded regions can be saved.
verifier.summaryOnly: Only totals are retained for this category; block pairs and coordinates are unavailable.
verifier.selectHint: Select a row from the list to highlight its coordinate in the world.
verifier.selectionHidden: The selected pair is hidden by the current search.
verifier.coordinateHint: Coordinates are ordered by distance at scan start. Select a row or coordinate to highlight it. Hover a pair to read its full names and states.
verifier.countHint: Category counts cover the full scan; table counts cover retained results.
materials.unknownKinds: Unknown inventory: %zu kinds (omitted from shortage filter)
materials.scope: Ignore lasts for this loaded blueprint only; reload resets it. HUD, placement and verification remain unchanged.
materials.inventoryHint: Counts include decoded contents of carried shulkers. Absent box NBT cannot distinguish empty from unavailable. Shortage compares the whole blueprint.
materials.loading: Materials pending. Return to the game to update inventory.
materials.failed: Save failed. Check the destination and error.
materials.exportStopping: Export is stopping. Close any save prompt and retry disable/unload.
materials.exportHint: Save the current view/counts as UTF-8 TSV, including original/excluded totals.
